arg.name: dev
arg.description: the linux file descriptor location for the camera

arg.name: sensor_type
arg.description: Physical sensor array size. Boson_320 or Boson_640. The driver cross-checks this against the V4L2-negotiated width and refuses to start on a mismatch.

arg.name: frame_rate
arg.description: Frame rate of the camera. Only 9.0/30.0/60.0 supported.

arg.name: video_mode
arg.description: Camera image format. YUV: camera-side AGC (mono8/bgr8, low CPU). RAW16: raw 16-bit thermal counts (mono16, no camera processing).

arg.name: zoom_enable
arg.description: Digital 2x upscale (320x256 -> 640x512) of the published image. Only available on Boson320 cameras.

arg.name: publish_color
arg.description: In YUV mode, publishes a bgr8 colorized image instead of mono8. Use this if a color palette (e.g., Rainbow) is enabled via the FLIR GUI. In RAW16 mode, this enables the heatmap image.

arg.name: raw16_agc_low_pct
arg.description: Bottom-tail clip percentage for RAW16 driver-side AGC (e.g. 1.0 discards the darkest 1% of pixels before linear stretch). Valid range [0, 50); invalid values revert to 1.0.

arg.name: raw16_agc_high_pct
arg.description: Top-tail clip percentage for RAW16 driver-side AGC (e.g. 1.0 discards the brightest 1% of pixels before linear stretch). Valid range [0, 50); invalid values revert to 1.0.

arg.name: camera_info_url
arg.description: Camera calibration file URL (file:// or package://). Empty publishes uncalibrated CameraInfo.

arg.name: point_x
arg.description: X coord of the temperature probe point.

arg.name: point_y
arg.description: Y coord of the temperature probe point.
